title: Studio: remove the global_nav mock command-palette preview, inspector and palette entries (objectui half of #6888)
body:
Objectui half of the #6888 retirement, split out at triage per multi-repo rule 2 (contract-first).

**Blocked-by: #6888**

## Scope (from the maintainer's 2026-08-09 ruling on #6888, direction 2)

Remove the Studio designer surfaces that promise a command-palette rendering the product does not have, once the spec retirement in #6888 lands and reaches this repo via the vendored pin:

- `packages/metadata-admin/previews/ActionPreview.tsx` — the mock `global_nav` command-palette preview frame (`:581-582` at the census SHA `b1204af0a1f7`);
- `packages/metadata-admin/inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx:132` — the `global_nav` inspector entry;
- `packages/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts:366` — the `global_nav` palette option.

The `action-bar.tsx` doc comment mentioning `global_nav` should be aligned in the same pass.

## Ordering

Contract-first: the spec half (#6888 — retire the member from `ACTION_LOCATIONS`, ADR-0087 registries, showcase declarers, QA checklist variant) fixes the vocabulary; this card consumes it. Do not start before #6888 is merged — until the member is out of the vendored spec, removing the designer entries would desync the designer from the still-declared vocabulary.

`target:v17` inherited from #6888 per the split rule (the obligation follows the work): the retirement is only true when the designer stops previewing the retired location; a v17 that ships the spec half without this half moves the declared≠enforced lie into the designer rather than ending it.
